OBJECTIVES
1. RC Parallel Circuit Troubleshooting Practice II

EQUIPMENT REQUIRED
Nida Experiment Card PC130 - 14B
In this lesson you will calculate branch currents in an RC parallel circuit.
INTRODUCTIONM
Then the computer may insert a fault into the circuit.
You will measure the circuit values and determine the type of fault, if a fault exists.
Let's begin the lesson on RC PARALLEL CIRCUIT TROUBLESHOOTING PRACTICE II...
LESSON MENU
The following experiments reinforce procedures used to troubleshoot RC parallel circuits. You will compare calculated circuit values with measured circuit values to determine if a fault exists.
EXPERIMENT

Adjust the Function Generator output level for 6 Vrms as measured by an analog meter. If measuring with an oscilloscope adjust the Function Generator output for 6 Vpp. this is Ea, measured across TP10 and TP1...
